card.name: Inside capitalized split words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of words written in ALL CAPS, such as headings and warnings, where a word is split into several parts. Also fires on a few capitalized name pieces like Ex or AL.

modes.label: All-caps word pieces
modes.description: A middle or early piece of an upper-case word in a heading or label text.

modes.label: Capitalized name pieces
modes.description: A short piece in a capitalized name or title split into parts.
modes.example: PALO<< AL>>TO – Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates is

card.writes: It seems to push toward word continuations and away from standalone topic words, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the middle of an upper-case word that has been broken into pieces, as in shouted headings.
